title: Comparative Study of Gender Identity Disorder Versus Control
official: Comparative Study of Gender Dysphoria Phenomenology and Neurophysiology: Clinical and Experimental Exploration of Gender Identity Disorder
summary: Gender dysphoria is manifested by an internal tension between biological sex and gender, that is, by a non-congruence, in the subjects who suffer from it, between their sex of birth and their social gender identity.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with gender dysphoria
* Without psychotropic
* Without hormono-therapy
* Without sexual surgery assignation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any depression
* Any addiction
